text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —The world is cruel.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
From the moment everyone is born, the 
cards they're dealt are already decided, 
and they don't get a choice—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No matter how weak, how few, or how 
battered your cards are, you have no 
choice but to fight with them...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Everyone says that's just the way the 
world works. But—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Do I just accept the hand I was dealt, 
give up on that dazzling view in the 
distance as 'another world,' and come to a 
halt?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Defying destiny, searching for a path to 
victory, screaming that there's no "other 
world," and fighting desperately to push 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Which one to choose... that's for us to 
decide for ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...It finally begins today. My... Twinkle 
Series...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(—The days up until now felt so long... 
yet went by in the blink of an eye.)

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—Swinging out to the far outside! She's 
in the lead!! Pulling away from the pack!! 
She crosses the line!!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Amazing, absolutely 
incredible!! What on earth is this...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(...When I was a kid. The sheer shock I 
felt when I first saw a race on TV.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Like cloudy skies clearing up in a single 
flash— there was a refreshing clarity 
there I'd never felt before.)

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Uoooooooh!! I'm not done yeeeet!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Getting fired up, unable to hold back, 
just running until I collapsed every 
single day. ...And then――)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, into the final stretch! Which girl 
will reach the finish line first?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(The pop-up racing clinic that came to my 
hometown. And the very first race I ever 
ran in my life—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(There was an unprecedented excitement and 
heat there. But more than that—)

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Dammit...! Dammit, dammit!! I lost...! I 
couldn't win...!!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Don't sweat it, Ace. It's not like 
we've ever run on a real track before...

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...There weren't any clubs, either. I just 
copied what I saw on TV and ran on my own.

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I know that, but still...! But isn't it 
frustrating?!

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
......It was never going to be a real 
contest. That place is just a completely 
"different world" from us.

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—What's up with that...!! Don't just give 
up that easily...!!

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't all of you love running, love 
racing?! Isn't that why you ran today? So 
why are you... Dammit!!"

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ace!!

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—I can run, and so can everyone else! We 
can win! And yet... and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Young Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just you waaaatch!! I am definitely, 
absolutely going to wiiiin!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(That fiery red passion that welled up 
inside me back then... is still driving me 
forward even now—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, break time's over. Let's do 
this, let's do thiiis!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I'll definitely win and move up, and 
prove it...! That anyone can win...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(That there's no such thing as a 
"different world"!!)

Starting today, our three-year journey 
through the Twinkle Series with Katsuragi 
Ace finally begins...!

Trying to keep my surging excitement in 
check, I arrived at the meeting spot with 
Katsuragi Ace, but—

Thinking it was unusual for her, I was 
pondering whether or not I should try 
contacting her—
(Murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

The track suddenly grows noisy, so I turn 
my gaze in that direction.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's CB-senpai...! Man, she really 
is so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I heard she's finally debuting this year! 
Still, what an amazing aura she has...—

The Umamusume drawing those passionate 
gazes was Mr. C.B. With her tremendous 
talent, she had been turning heads since 
before her debut.

She belongs to the same class as Katsuragi 
Ace, and is also someone Ace... looks up 
to.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe I'll run just a little bit 
more.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu— Hahahahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What was that run...! And to think 
she hasn't even debuted yet...!!

—The sight of Mr. C.B. bounding across the 
earth with joyous, powerful strides spoke 
of her hidden talent more eloquently than 
anything else ever could.
choice_data_list:
(...Someone of that caliber is going to be 
in my generation?)

text_block_list.text:
"...The road ahead for Katsuragi Ace. When 
forced to consider just how harsh it will 
be—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Sorry, Trainer! I'm late!!

Katsuragi Ace appeared drenched in sweat, 
looking like she had clearly done far more 
than just a light warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. I'm just so super excited for 
training starting today...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I was doing my usual morning run and got 
so pumped up— that before I knew it, it 
was time for our meetup!
choice_data_list: Then maybe you should rest for a bit...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I'm fine, totally fine! More importantly, 
let me train while I'm still warmed up 
inside and out!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Unless I train like crazy like that—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Because there's no way I can catch up to 
her...!

In her eyes as she gazed at Mr. C.B., 
there burned a fighting spirit even 
stronger than her admiration. There was 
not the slightest trace of intimidation.

As Katsuragi Ace's Trainer, I want to 
cherish this fiery motivation of hers 
moving forward...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, as expected of you, Trainer! You 
really get it~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to get fired up— Let's do 
this!

"And so, our first day of training with 
Katsuragi Ace flew by and came to an end—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Haaaah~! That really hits the spot~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good work to you too, Trainer-san! 
Thanks to that, I'm completely pooped~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer. Got a moment after 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: There's somewhere I'd like to go with you.

—Guided by Katsuragi Ace, I arrived at a 
hilltop overlooking the entirety of Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Right~? The sky looks so huge from up 
here—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
While I'm looking up like this... I can 
believe there are no walls in this 
world... and that everything connects, on 
and on forever.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Like, all the way from Tracen Academy— to 
the countryside where I was born and 
raised, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Allow me to declare it once 
again, right here and now.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely become someone...! 
Someone who smashes through foolish common 
sense and impossibly high walls—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Fearing no rival and no race. An existence 
proving there is no such thing as a 
'different realm'—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Becoming the "Ace" of the Umamusume 
world!!!

Between those words, the fire blazing in 
her eyes, and her commanding stance, I was 
almost dazzled.

A feeling close to conviction wells up 
within me... that if it's her, she truly 
can become the "Ace"...!
choice_data_list:
Then let me make my declaration anew as 
well!

In that case, I'll make a declaration of 
my own too!

text_block_list.text:
Matching Katsuragi Ace, I clenched my 
fist, putting my feelings into words so as 
not to be outdone by her fiery passion.
choice_data_list: I will definitely make you the "ace"!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Now that's what I'm talking about...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now that that's settled— let's 
put our arms around each other's 
shoulders, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Put some spirit into it, spirit! Come on, 
hurry!

—Putting their arms around each other's 
shoulders as told, they line up and clench 
their fists.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!! Let's give it all we've 
gooooot!!!

Hoping the fists we thrust into the air 
together will one day reach the top— we 
shouted into the evening sky.

—And so began my days of challenging the 
world alongside Katsuragi Ace!!
